name: Headroom — Context Compression
tagline: A proxy that compresses LLM context to cut token cost and speed sessions.
description: A local proxy sitting in front of the model API that compresses and caches conversation context, reducing tokens per turn while preserving the working state of long sessions.

page.objective: Make long AI working sessions cheaper and faster without losing context.
page.problem: Long sessions re-send large context every turn, wasting tokens and time.
page.solution: A transparent proxy that compresses and caches context between turns.

highlights.headline: A local proxy that compresses Claude's context before the API call.
points: Installed 2026-06-11; runs as a live compression proxy on port 8787.
Gated by a dedicated launcher — only claude-fable-5 sessions route through it.
Compresses via tokenizers + ONNX + a Rust core, no GPU needed.
